title: Establish 0.2.12 full-domain carrier libm accuracy and exact constrained flags
description: Dialect b-dialect-spec-1av sections 13.3-13.5 adds a NEW full-domain one-local-ulp envelope for unconstrained own-format carrier transcendentals on all seven formats, pair fields separately, exact modf and sequenced powi semantics. Constrained directed modes select the proper side within the envelope; nearest modes select the actual nearest neighbour with specified ties. Invalid/pole/overflow/tininess-after-rounding/inexact derive from the exact mathematical operation, not approximation work or empirical pack flags. Existing v1 MPFR sweeps (<=4 ulp test threshold, <=1 exhaustive half/bfloat sin) are measured samples, not a proof/full-domain bound or exact-flag evidence. Keep capability, no subset ratification: independent adversarial/high-precision or certified-interval evidence for full exponents, near zeros/poles/subnormal/overflow and exact special values; report lowered only when complete contract is met. Coordinate PPC pair semantics 4yg. 1av stays open pending this evidence.

title: Meet 0.2.12 PPC exact-sum conversion and canonical-pair rounding guarantees
description: Dialect b-dialect-spec-dfd sections 13.1/13.5 and binding 0.2.10 errata prioritize explicit exactness/correct-rounding over APFloat implementation fallbacks. High+low exact value must drive conversions (e.g. high=1, low=2^-60 to x86_fp80 retains 1+2^-60), in-range unsigned conversion cannot saturate because low is negative, and sqrt/FMA/integral rounding must meet canonical two-binary64 pair rules rather than inaccurate legacy contiguous106 fallback. Pair canonicalization, tie/overflow/subnormal handling and final-operation constrained flags are specified; preserve rint vs nearbyint flag differences. Same-major APFloat matching tests alone do not establish these explicit guarantees. Keep full capability; independent high-precision exact-value/edge/reversal evidence required, not a narrowed producer semantics claim.

title: Specify signaling constrained comparison ABI without losing fcmps flags
description: Contract clarification blocker, no capability removed. Determining dialect 0.2.10 §13.5 sentence: llvm.experimental.constrained.<op> becomes the soft-float call of §13.1 with suffix _rm and an extra i32 R operand; non-ignore exception behavior ORs IEEE flags into __bennett_rt_fenv.flags. Both LLVM 18 and 23 define constrained.fcmp (quiet) and constrained.fcmps (signaling). §13.1 only supplies cmp_B(C,C,i32 P), where P is restricted to LLVM predicates 0..15. The same carrier operands, P and R cannot tell these two exception behaviors apart for quiet-NaN inputs. Required exact contract change: specify a distinct cmps_B_rm(C,C,i32 P,i32 R) spelling (or an explicit signaling operand/encoded predicate extension), including quiet-NaN invalid semantics and the normalisation mapping. Current cmp_B_rm implements quiet comparison, raising invalid on signaling NaN; signaling comparison remains required and tracked, never silently treated as quiet.
notes: Exact signaling/quiet ABI ambiguity filed as b-dialect-spec-21a (consumer,dialect,arith), with §13.1/13.5 quote and both readings. Quiet cmp_B_rm is present for all seven formats; signaling remains required and cannot be substituted silently. Plugin unchanged.

title: Own-format deterministic transcendental libm and arbitrary-width powi
description: Mechanics staged for every one of the seven formats, never rejected or trapped. Determining dialect 0.2.10 §13.4 sentences: All seven source formats remain covered on every supported platform; a format different from D is neither rejected nor trapped. These linked bennett-arith/runtimes functions implement the named operation numerically in B, using the same deterministic, versioned implementation in both builds. Implement sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh exp exp2 exp10 log log2 log10 pow sincos sincospi, plus powi_iK for K other than implemented i32. Include own-format precision, zeros, NaNs, reduction extremes, subnormal-output sweeps and all aggregate field orders. Correct rounding not required for §13.4, determinism is.
notes:
All seven own-format libm families implemented and MPFR-tested; 130464 main +137860 exhaustive/PPC/rounding +14655 subnormal/overflow checks per major. Ordinary maximum reported error 0.5 ulp, not a correct-rounding/global-bound proof. All exact-width powi supported by generator; ten default widths through i1025, custom i7 publication executed. Contract accuracy/flags question 1av retained; metadata schema/signaling remain separate 38c/chn blockers.
Focused final boundary: LLVM18/23 MAX_INT_BITS is inclusive 8388608. Exact i8388608 powi wrapper assembles/verifies on both majors. Default bitcodes remain byte-identical to bb79deb; manifest provenance updated.
close_reason: Published and verified on LLVM18/23; independent black-box oracle suites green, reproducible artifacts and explicit contract interpretations recorded. See docs/verification.json.

title: Implement PPCDoubleDouble per LLVM-major APFloat semantics
description: Mechanics staged, no capability removed. Determining dialect 0.2.10 §13.1 sentence: ppc_fp128 is double-double with the operations of LLVM’s APFloat PPCDoubleDouble semantics of the major in use. §13.3: All seven formats of §13.1 are covered by the same table and contract. Implement all scalar operations, wide conversions, directed rounding, NaN/denormal handling and all cross-format routes for ppcf128, tested independently on 18 and 23; never substitute binary128 or binary64.
notes: Published all PPC scalar/wide/conversion concrete entries. Final same-major oracle: 792786 checks each, plus sparse boundary/classification/modf/ldexp coverage. Explicit APFloat-priority interpretation and missing sqrt policy documented under b-dialect-spec-dfd. All original 1029583 checks remain green. No idealized IEEE double-double claim.
close_reason: Published and verified on LLVM18/23; independent black-box oracle suites green, reproducible artifacts and explicit contract interpretations recorded. See docs/verification.json.

title: M1 integer-only soft-float bitcode and dual-major oracle gate
description: Implement dialect 0.2.10 @023f5a7 §13.1 entry points and §13.5 rounding; publish LLVM 18/23 binary edges, independent oracle tests, gate and clean-sha pre-push. Full seven-format and operation scope retained; stage remaining mechanics in sentence-citing beads.
close_reason: Published staged M1 binary edge on both LLVM majors: 606 integer-only exports for six formats, 1,029,583 independent numerical checks per major and byte-identical rebuilds; clean pushed-SHA isolation tested. Full scope retained through r3d, 0he, 38c and contract clarification chn; no full seven-format/DF conformance claim.

title: Metadata-named arbitrary APFloat format conversion families
description: Mechanics staged without reducing format capability. Determining dialect 0.2.10 §13.1 row: llvm.convert.to.arbitrary.fp, llvm.convert.from.arbitrary.fp (format named by metadata) become __bennett_sf_convert_to_<fmt>_B / __bennett_sf_convert_from_<fmt>_B with LLVM APFloat’s semantics of the named format. Generate format-specific signatures from metadata, implement numerical conversion independently for both majors, and retain all seven input/output formats. The pinned contract does not enumerate metadata names, so manifest records a parametric family rather than inventing a finite list.
notes: Dialect schema blocker filed as b-dialect-spec-z7u (consumer,dialect,arith), quoting §13.1 and both finite-name vs metadata-defined format readings. Plugin expectation tables contain no concrete arbitrary-format name/carrier schema to instantiate. Full capability retained; no placeholder. Existing concrete routes for all seven source formats are now published; this bead concerns metadata-defined families only.
